0.text: Leave Pallet Town north onto Route 1.
0.hint: The north exit is a two-tile gap in the top tree line, north of the open ground between the two houses. Walk to it, then straight up. Do not walk south into the water.
0.heading: up

12.text: Walk north through Route 1 to Viridian City.
12.hint: Route 1 runs straight north to Viridian City. Ledges only drop south.
12.heading: up

1.text: Enter the Viridian Mart to buy POKé BALLs.
1.hint: The Mart is the building with the blue roof.

42.text: Top up to ten capture balls: buy the best affordable stocked ball, Ultra then Great then Poké Ball.
42.hint: The clerk stands behind the counter on the left. Face him across it and press A.

50.text: Leave the gate south, back toward Viridian for POKé BALLs.
50.hint: The exit is at the bottom of the gate.

51.text: Leave the forest by the south gate, back toward Viridian for POKé BALLs.
51.hint: The south gate is at the bottom right.
